column1: # Spec-example coverage baseline (C445). One row per example suite:
# mapped        examples really asserted (a Go type is registered for the root element)
# unmapped      examples SKIPPED with "No Go type mapped" — what this ratchet exists for
# out-of-scope  examples skipped through a suite's outOfScope map, with a written reason
# The check (spec/spectest/coverage.go) is one-directional: mapped may only
# rise, unmapped and out-of-scope may only fall. Modeling more types therefore
# never requires touching this file first; shrinking the model does, and that
# edit is what makes the loss reviewable instead of a green run with more skips.
# The xlsx (SML) rows are the outlier and read as a debt figure: a majority of
# the SML examples have no modeled type, against 0 unmapped for WML/PML/DML.

column2: sort spec/spectest/coverage_baseline.tsv.observed   # then paste the rows below
